name: poisoned_non_contiguous_provider_pair_sum
description: Real production fallback (2026-09-10): the LLM combined Tencent (#1) and Zhipu AI (#3), skipping DeepSeek (#2), stating 35.6% combined. No provider_share_cumulative entry covers a non-contiguous subset, so this is derived arithmetic the prompt (v5) forbids and the number-validator must still reject — widening _fmt_pct's rounding tolerance must not let an arbitrary provider-pair sum through.

poisoned_output.headline: Tencent and Zhipu AI pull ahead
poisoned_output.summary: Tencent and Zhipu AI together account for 35.6% of all tokens.
